messages:
Sam: Quick sync  post-launch: analytics missing sessions for some enterprise customers. Need to decide micro-sprint scope.
Elaine: Data gaps are causing billing mismatch alerts. Customers flagged it as urgent.
Rohit: Root cause: ingestion drop when payload size > 256KB. Seen in two tenants with heavy event batches.
Marta: We also have an enhancement request to add a per-route feature-toggle for live debug traces (worth 0.5 NPS). Low effort ~3 dev-days.
Sam: Tradeoff: fix ingestion gap (P0 for affected accounts) vs ship toggle that helps debugging future issues but not urgent.
Rohit: Fix paths: A) quick patch to split large batches on ingest (est 2 dev-days + QA). B) deeper pipeline rewrite (est 3w).
QA-Jen: Acceptance for patch: no lost events for the repro set, retention metrics unchanged, and no extra duplication.
PM-Cleo: Business wants minimal customer impact. Recommend patch now, schedule toggle after. Also need comms.
Marta: Can the toggle be scoped as a small parallel task? It depends on Rohits bandwidth.
Rohit: If we prioritize patch, I can allocate 1 engineer to the toggle as side work (might slip).
Sam: Proposal: 1) emergency patch (owner Rohit) to split batches and restore ingestion. 2) Add toggle as follow-on but try to push 1 engineer to it if capacity allows. 3) Create milestone "analytics-pipeline-rewrite" for long-term fix.
PM-Cleo: I'll draft customer note and open milestone ticket with dependencies.
Elaine: Also add retroaction: introduce load tests with 500KB and 1MB payloads to CI.
Rohit: Will add unit tests and a new integration test. Branch: fix/ingest-split-1735. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/901 (WIP).
ops-bot: Canary requested for 2024-08-05T09:00Z for service "analytics-ingest". Canary policy: 24h, monitor event-loss metric.
QA-Jen: Smoke passed on canary. Integration tests show no event loss for the sampled corpora. Running longer run now.
Marta: I'll draft the toggle ticket: FEATURE-2277, estimate 3d, label "follow-on:debug-toggle".
Sam: Decision recap: prioritize ingestion patch -> deploy canary -> monitor 24h -> prod. Toggle is follow-on, try to staff 1 engineer. Long-term rewrite tracked as milestone. Owners: Rohit (patch), Marta (toggle), PM-Cleo (comms), QA-Jen (tests).
PM-Cleo: Notifying customers with interim mitigation note and ETA for full pipeline plan.
Rohit: Merged to canary, starting rollout.
ops-bot: Production rollout scheduled at 2024-08-06T02:30Z if canary metrics remain green.
QA-Jen: Canary 24h complete, no event loss, no perf impact. Ready for prod.
Sam: Thanks team. Closing thread  patch applied, toggle ticket parked as follow-on, rewrite milestone created. :white_check_mark:
